style: Exact approved 6-head adult arctic fox woman, same narrow side profile, calm blue eye, short white bob, white cloth hood hanging on back, white wide-sleeve tunic gray-blue diamond cuffs/hem, gray-blue pants, white boots, one white tail with dark outline. Preserve approved face pixel shapes and palette, NO redesign, NO front turn, NO gradients, no new accessories. Same body scale throughout; top-left screen lighting. Camera fixed; pivot stays fixed. Clear chunky pixel clusters. Render on a TRUE 180x180 logical pixel grid. Full figure including ears is exactly 156 logical pixels tall. Pixel squares identical everywhere. Copy base eye exactly. White areas #F4F7FA, shadows #C3CCD8 and #8C97AD; pants #8C97AD/#5B637F; outlines #383C55. No nearly-black pixels. No new palette.

idle.action: All 4 poses face screen right exactly like base. Tiny breathing cycle: rest, down 1px, down 2px, down 1px. Feet immobile. Eye remains calm and open. Subtle tail follow-through. No stepping. Same head silhouette and eye. Do NOT change foot pixels, head shape, eye, hair volume, pants creases or tunic width. Only 0,1,2,1 pixel vertical breathing displacement in upper body, legs bend minimally to absorb this. All four soles identical baseline and x. No scaling.

walk.action: STRICT EIGHT DISTINCT POSES. Face right entire cycle. Near leg N is foreground and lighter; far leg F behind and darker. Frame1 N heel far right on floor, F toe far left on floor. Frame2 N supports body, F heel lifts behind. Frame3 N support vertical, F knee swings FORWARD toward right, F boot airborne in FRONT of support leg. Frame4 N toe trails left, F shin extends right before heel strike. Frame5 F heel far right, N toe far left, foreground N leg clearly slopes BACKWARD (opposite frame1). Frame6 F supports body, N lifts behind. Frame7 F support vertical, N knee forward toward right, N boot airborne in FRONT. Frame8 F toe trails left, N shin reaches right. Next returns to1. Never duplicate frames1-4 as5-8. Feet alternate support. Arms swing opposite corresponding legs. Head and eye copied from reference. Same scale every pose. No hops, no moonwalking.
